verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents two in-product AI capabilities. Cortex Analyst turns natural-language questions into answers "without writing SQL", grounded in Semantic Views defined on your schemas. Cortex Code is an "AI-driven coding agent integrated into Snowflake". However, the evidence never explicitly says either one writes SQL for the user to see and edit, fixes broken SQL, or explains queries. missing for 10: explicit documentation of NL-to-visible-SQL authoring in the editor, SQL error fixing, SQL explanation, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a built-in AI assistant writes, fixes, and explains SQL against my schemas from natural language, inside the product

citations.quote: With Cortex Analyst, business users can ask questions in natural language and receive direct answers without writing SQL.
Cortex Code — AI-driven coding agent integrated into Snowflake for data engineering workflows.
You can store semantic business concepts directly in the database in a Semantic View, which is a schema-level object.
